items.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) Wins Wider FDA Clearance For Blood Cancer Monitoring
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) received expanded FDA clearance for its EXENT Analyser with the Immunoglobulin Isotypes (GAM) Assay. The decision covers use in monitoring multiple myeloma and Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, broadening the EXENT system's clinical utility. The GAM Assay is intended to support more detailed tracking of disease activity and treatment response in complex blood cancer patients. items.title: Should Illumina Stock Holders Look At Thermo Fisher Instead?
items.summary: Illumina and Thermo Fisher Scientific both sell the tools labs use to study biology and find new drugs. They part ways on focus. Illumina is built around gene sequencing machines and their supplies. Thermo Fisher sells to many kinds of labs, with $47.4 billion of yearly revenue against Illumina's $4.5 billion.
